=== FINDINGS FROM qwen_qwen3_7-plus ===
- scripts/untrusted_process_sandbox.sh:449-456 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  PROBLEM: The fix adds the guard's git directory to `git_metadata_paths` via `append_git_metadata_path`, but the enforcement loop at lines 449-456 makes all git metadata paths `InaccessiblePaths` when `provider_required=true` (which is the case for workspace-guard role, set at line 60). The workspace-guard runs `git check-ignore` (post_agent_workspace_guard.py:166-176) which requires reading the git metadata. Making the git dir inaccessible causes git to fail with an error code other than 0 or 1, triggering `GuardError("git ignore classification failed")`.
  WHY: In production (non-test mode), the systemd sandbox enforces `InaccessiblePaths` on the git metadata directory. When the workspace-guard process runs `git -C <workspace> check-ignore`, git attempts to access the git directory pointed to by `GIT_DIR`, but systemd blocks the access. Git fails with exit code 128 (or similar), which `_is_ignored` treats as a classification failure. The test passes only because `UNTRUSTED_PROCESS_SANDBOX_TEST_MODE=1` bypasses systemd sandboxing entirely (lines 342-356), running the command with plain `env -i`. The test does not verify that the systemd sandbox allows the guard to read the git metadata.
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: The manifest inventory `.ai/.workspace_source_manifest.txt` should list all changelog fragments present in the `changelog.d/` directory.
  Expected change site: `.ai/.workspace_source_manifest.txt` — should include `changelog.d/4392-workspace-guard-git-context.md` (the new fragment this PR creates).
  Evidence of absence: The PR creates `changelog.d/4392-workspace-guard-git-context.md` (visible in the diff as a new file), but the manifest diff only adds `changelog.d/4338-review-editor-sandbox-init.md` (a previously-created fragment). A grep for `changelog.d/4392` in the manifest returns no matches. The manifest is a sorted inventory of workspace source files; every other changelog fragment present on disk is listed in it. This is a minor inventory inconsistency.
  severity=low | confidence=[4]
